title: Making a demake souls like 2.5d
author: Key-Soft-8248
selftext:
I improved my game that you might have seen here a couple of days ago. 

Home it's now it a better state :)

comments.author: HealthyWest6482
comments.body: Looks good. I can see the Codex signature "explain every single fucking interaction on screen with writing". I usually drill its asshole for that, but other than that I really like the atmosphere and style.

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body:
Indeed I need to hide some 😅
If you have a mobile [try ](https://indieben.itch.io/cendre-test-3)
Let me know how it goes:)

comments.author: kryptondog
comments.body: Looking good, I like the art style!

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body: Thanks ! I used sprite fusion for characters :) ( and ai generated textures for some 3d elements)

comments.author: ScarletRed-dit
comments.body:
This is cool! I’ve played the series (even og demon souls) way back and it’s refreshing to see a different version of it. Reminds me of [this video.](https://youtu.be/vUl19SCttaM?si=0oHL0ytdrgWY9V0Z)

I’m new to these things. What software/ai etc. did you use for the whole development, and which ones are used for what purpose?

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body:
Thanks ! Yes that video was awesome ! But unfortunately they never made a real game of it 😅 ( but I love their content ). So mostly got 5.7 Sol in Work ( because I did it all from my phone ) and for characters I used Sprite fusion. 
Music and sound effects from itch.io , pixel font from Google font. Original inspiration : Bleaksword ( an indie game published by devolver )

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body:
If you want to give it a try [link ](https://indieben.itch.io/cendre-test-3)

But better on mobile for now :)

comments.author: Important-Size6996
comments.body: That's great! It encourages me to keep creating my game. I enjoyed the game; it's quite easy to understand, and I can't wait to learn more about the story. Congratulations!

replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body: Thanks ! Good luck with your project don't hesitate to share it here for feedback :)

But better on mobile for now. I need to make it desktop / laptop friendly 😅 let me know how it goes !
